question: If “he loves coffee“ is coded as 123; “coffee has caffeine” is coded as 245; “he coffee caffeine” is coded as 125 and “caffeine is bad” is coded as 567 then “he” is represented by:
solution:
The logic followed here is:

“he loves coffee“ is coded as 123

“coffee has caffeine” is coded as 245

“he coffee caffeine” is coded as 125

“caffeine is bad” is coded as 567

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb8e6e03f3bf8c2194a9b4ed97d7770881c9e079265805300b2e786141194b44.png]

'he' is represented by '1'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
